body.name: v2.6.0
body.body:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **`Result.deserialize` now returns `ResultDeserializationError` instead of `null`** (#29)
  - Adds `ResultDeserializationError` tagged error class
  - `Result.deserialize` returns `Result<T, E | ResultDeserializationError>` instead of `Result<T, E> | null`
  - Allows handling deserialization failures using the same Result utilities as everything else

- **Compile-time protection against async in `Result.try`** (#30) by @trvswgnr
  - Prevents a footgun where `Result.try` silently accepts async functions
  - TypeScript now rejects async functions at compile time, guiding users toward `Result.tryPromise`

### Fixes

- Fix opensrc repository URL (#28)
- Remove recursive publish script

### Docs

- Fix TaggedError example in JSDoc (#27)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/compare/v2.5.2...v2.6.0

body.name: v2.5.0
body.body:
## What's Changed

### Internal Consistency
- Replace `throw new Error` with `panic()` across error paths for consistent error handling
  - `Err.unwrap()` now uses `panic()` instead of throwing raw `Error`
  - `Err[Symbol.iterator]` unreachable path uses `panic()`
  - `assertResult` validation uses `panic()` for invalid generator returns

### Code Quality
- Apply oxfmt formatting throughout `result.ts`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/compare/v2.4.0...v2.5.0

body.name: v2.3.0
body.body:
## v2.3.0

### New Features

- **`Result.flatten()`** — Unwrap nested `Result<Result<T, E>, E>` into `Result<T, E>` ([#15](https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/pull/15))
  ```typescript
  const nested: Result<Result<number, Error>, Error> = Result.ok(Result.ok(42));
  const flat: Result<number, Error> = Result.flatten(nested);
  ```

- **`Result.partition()`** — Split an array of Results into separate `ok` and `err` arrays ([#11](https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/pull/11))
  ```typescript
  const [successes, failures] = Result.partition(results);
  ```

- **`isOk()` / `isErr()` type guards** — Instance methods for type narrowing in conditionals ([#13](https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/pull/13))
  ```typescript
  if (result.isOk()) {
    console.log(result.value); // typed as T
  }
  ```

### Bug Fixes

- **Err covariance fix** — `Err` is now covariant in phantom `T` via `never` params, enabling ergonomic early returns without explicit type annotations ([#16](https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/pull/16))


## New Contributors
* @isaacharrisholt made their first contribution in https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/pull/11

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dmmulroy/better-result/compare/v2.1.0...v2.3.0
